result.summary: A dark-themed chat or agent composer input widget with a large multiline text area on top and a control bar below. The text area shows placeholder text 'Type a task for the agent (Enter to send)...'. The bottom control bar contains, left to right, a plus icon, a 'Full Access' selector with a red dot, an '@ Agent' selector, a 'Type a mod...' selector with a blue icon, and a green up-arrow send button. The widget has rounded corners, a subtle border, and a divider separating the input area from the controls.
